lines.t: (We remember you)
The night was quiet, yet heavy with knowing
Bread in Your hands, a mercy unfolding
You spoke of a body soon broken in love
A covenant written from heaven above
A covenant written from heaven above
The cup You lifted, a promise of grace
Red as the mercy poured out in our place
You called us to remember, not just with words
But hearts awakened to all we have heard
In the stillness, we see
What it cost to set us free
In the stillness, we see
What it cost to set us free
We remember You
In the breaking of the bread
In the pouring of the wine
Every word You said
We remember You
Lifted high upon that tree
We remember You
Lifted high upon that tree
Your body given, Your blood for me
Betrayed in the garden, alone in the night
Carrying sorrow, yet walking in light
No one could bear what You carried for all
Still You surrendered, still answered the call
Pierced for our healing, crushed for our sin
Love poured out so we could begin again
No greater kindness the world has known
You gave Your life to reclaim Your own
And the veil was torn in two
So we could come to You
We remember You
In the breaking of the bread
In the pouring of the wine
Every word You said
We remember You
Lifted high upon that tree
Your body given, Your blood for me
Not forgotten, not in vain
Every drop, every pain
Still it speaks, still it saves
Calling hearts out of the grave
You are risen, You are King
Still we gather, still we sing
Till You come, we proclaim
Every power in Your name
We remember You
In the breaking of the bread
In the pouring of the wine
Every word You said
We remember You
Lamb of God who set us free
Forever worthy, eternally
Till You return, we will stand and proclaim
YahuShua The Messiah, forever the same
(We remember you)
(We remember you)
